findings.reason: mwl8k priv->stream_lock is shared between the mac80211 .tx transmit path and process/workqueue context but is never taken with spin_lock_bh (no spin_lock_bh(&priv->stream_lock) exists anywhere in the file). Softirq-side chain: qdisc dequeue / NET_TX softirq -> ndo_start_xmit (ieee80211_subif_start_xmit) -> __ieee80211_tx -> drv_tx -> mwl8k_tx (mwl8k.c:4684, calls mwl8k_txq_xmit at 4698) -> mwl8k_txq_xmit (1893) -> spin_lock(&priv->stream_lock) at 1987 (and 2051, 2074, 2124) with plain spin_lock. Process/workqueue-side chains taking the same lock plainly: (a) hardirq mwl8k_interrupt BA_WATCHDOG branch (4613) -> ieee80211_queue_work(&priv->watchdog_ba_handle) -> worker mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events (3813) -> spin_lock(&priv->stream_lock) at 3830; (b) mwl8k_ampdu_action (5453) from cfg80211/mac80211 process context; (c) mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del (4160) from sta-removal process context. Untrusted source is attacker-influenced concurrency: any QoS data frame to an HT station (or hardware BA-watchdog interrupt) triggers the two sides. Missing guarantee: plain spin_lock only disables preemption, not bottom halves, so while a worker/user task holds stream_lock on a CPU, a NET_TX softirq on that CPU executing mwl8k_txq_xmit spins forever on stream_lock while the preempted holder can never resume -> soft lockup, RCU stall, device TX stall DoS — the exact seed mechanism (ks7010 tx_dev_lock). Counterevidence checked: the very same function mwl8k_txq_xmit takes priv->tx_lock with spin_lock_bh at 2059 and 2120, and process-context tx_lock users use spin_lock_bh (1573-1626), proving the driver itself treats this xmit path as BH-enabled; the sibling lock tx_lock is correctly disciplined (tasklet mwl8k_tx_poll at 4642 uses plain spin_lock only in softirq context), isolating the defect to stream_lock. Confidence medium: static call-chain analysis only, no runtime reproducer (snapshot lacks build config); the .tx callback is reachable under NET_TX softirq via the standard mac80211 qdisc-dequeue path.

candidates.reason: spin_lock(&priv->tx_dev.tx_dev_lock) at 398 is the seed demonstration itself (present unpatched in this tree); explicitly excluded from reporting per instructions.

priv->tx_lock is correctly disciplined: process/tx-context sites use spin_lock_bh (1573, 1586, 1592, 2059, 2120) and the only plain spin_lock (4642) is inside tasklet mwl8k_tx_poll, i.e., softirq context where plain spin_lock is appropriate; no missing-BH site found.

wil->net_queue_lock: the plain wil_update_net_queues (spin_lock at 2305) is called only from NAPI TX poll softirq contexts (wil_tx_complete at txrx.c:2551, reached from wil6210_netdev_poll_tx netdev.c:133-155, and wil_tx_sring_handler txrx_edma.c:1308); the xmit-side caller wil_start_xmit uses the _bh variant (2313); no process-context plain caller of this lock was found.

txdata->lock is taken with plain spin_lock in wil_is_tx_idle (txrx.c:76-104) which runs in the process-context suspend path (pm.c:201, wil_suspend_keep_radio_on), while the xmit path takes the same lock plainly in wil_tx_ring (txrx.c:2200) from wil_start_xmit (ndo_start_xmit, NET_TX softirq); a softirq-vs-holder window exists, but wil_pm_stop_all_net_queues() is called before wil_is_tx_idle and all other txdata->lock sites use spin_lock_bh (txrx.c:1125,1217,1228,1315,1387,1395; txrx_edma.c:734,1580; wmi.c:3929,3975; main.c:210), so whether a concurrent xmit softirq can still execute during the window was not conclusively established before finalize.

priv->wsm_cmd.lock is taken plainly at wsm.c:1088,1091,1115,1130,1149,1325,1402,1676,1768 (wsm_cmd_send wait loops and command submit) and debug.c:250; the cw1200 device interaction runs through a dedicated 'bh' kernel thread (process context) rather than a softirq callback, and TX-side softirq reachability of these sites was not traced to completion before finalize.

ctl_node->resp_lock taken with plain spin_lock at trans.c:30,47,87,136 while qtnfmac bus locks (tx_lock, tx_reclaim_lock, irq_lock) all use spin_lock_irqsave; whether any resp_lock site is reachable from the xmit/TX-completion softirq path was not traced before finalize.

limitations: Bounded search: drivers/net/wireless and drivers/staging wireless trees were ranked by plain spin_lock density (222 plain spin_lock sites in drivers/net/wireless); deep softirq-reachability analysis was completed only for mwl8k, wil6210, ks7010 and partially for cw1200 and qtnfmac.

iwlwifi pcie/rx.c (23 plain spin_lock sites), pcie/tx.c (4), and intersil hostap hostap_ap.c/hostap_hw.c (24 combined) ranked highest by density but were not analyzed before the intent was stopped; these merit a follow-up pass.

The mwl8k stream_lock finding is a static hypothesis: no runtime reproducer was built because the snapshot tree lacks .config/headers for standalone driver builds; exploit impact (soft-lockup/RCU-stall DoS) is inferred from the standard NET_TX softirq preemption model, not demonstrated.

wil6210 txdata->lock (wil_is_tx_idle suspend path vs wil_tx_ring xmit path), cw1200 wsm_cmd.lock, and qtnfmac trans.c resp_lock remain unresolved; their deadlock windows were identified but reachability was not concluded.
